title: Try Action on your Mac
description: Install Action, grant permissions, and take your first screenshot.
prerequisites: macOS on Apple Silicon, with Bun installed. No source build needed.

steps.title: Install and launch
steps.expected: Action.app opens from Applications. The CLI is available as lats.

steps.title: Allow access
steps.command:
lats action call permissions.request
lats action call permissions.snapshot
steps.expected: Approve Accessibility and Screen Recording in macOS, then run the second command. Both permissions should report granted.

steps.title: Take a screenshot
steps.expected: The reply reports status: screenshot. Your main display capture opens in Preview. This captures your screen, not a private workspace.

troubleshooting: Agent not reachable? Run lats action launch, then retry. Permission denied? Enable Action in System Settings → Privacy & Security, quit and reopen Action, then check permissions again.
agentNote: The app download includes native capture. Agent-driven browser work and the virtual workspaces in the demo also need the matching MCP runtime and host preflight.
linuxNote: Linux uses a remote lattices-host connection, not the macOS app. Available actions depend on the host; macOS overlays and Accessibility are not available there.
